title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2610.40747v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective computer-use agents (CUAs) should seamlessly combine visual GUI interaction with code and terminal execution within a single policy. We present Mage-VL-Cowork, a 4B hybrid CUA trained from a general multimodally aligned checkpoint through an end-to-end, progressive five-stage curriculum across midtraining, SFT, and RL. To power this curriculum at scale, Mage-CUA-Forge replaces per-task agent construction with reusable, skill-conditioned generation workflows and application-specific preparers, synthesizing 293,806 desktop and web tasks across 6,915 skills while reducing recurring per-task expenditure by 82.6%. Rather than directly distilling a default teacher, we evolve the teacher harness and instantiate specialized CUA harnesses to yield high-quality trajectories alongside stage-specific supervision. translated_title: Mage-VL-Cowork：一种从进化式测试框架中学习混合计算机使用的完整训练配方
translated_abstract: 有效的计算机使用智能体（CUA）应当能够在单一策略中无缝地结合视觉GUI交互与代码和终端执行。我们提出了Mage-VL-Cowork，这是一个4B规模的混合型计算机使用智能体，它从通用多模态对齐的检查点出发，通过涵盖中期训练、SFT和RL的端到端渐进式五阶段课程进行训练。为了大规模支撑这一课程体系，Mage-CUA-Forge用可复用的、技能条件化的生成工作流和面向特定应用的准备器取代了逐个任务的智能体构建方式，合成了涵盖6,915项技能的293,806个桌面和网络任务，同时将每个任务的经常性开销降低了82.6%。我们没有直接蒸馏默认的教师模型，而是对教师测试框架进行进化，并实例化专门的CUA测试框架，从而产生高质量的轨迹以及阶段特定的监督信号。Mage-VL-Cowork-4B最终通过不同的训练阶段在OSWorld-Verified上攀升至66.0%，同时具有更高效的推理。
tldr: 提出了Mage-VL-Cowork——一个4B混合型计算机使用智能体，通过五阶段渐进式训练课程、可大规模低成本合成任务的Mage-CUA-Forge以及进化式教师框架生成高质量轨迹，在OSWorld-Verified上达到66.0%的性能。
en_tdlr: Mage-VL-Cowork is a 4B hybrid computer-use agent trained via a progressive five-stage curriculum, leveraging scalable low-cost task synthesis with Mage-CUA-Forge and evolved teacher harnesses for high-quality trajectories, achieving 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified.
